# The updatebot image installs compiled dependency pins before launching its vendoring client

This human landing raises MozPhab from 1.5.1 to 2.15.3 and pip-tools from 7.3.0 to 7.5.3 in both input and compiled requirements. Docker copies the compiled file; setup passes it to make_venv, links moz-phab and launches vendor in that environment. ExtendedConduit still delegates repository detection to mozphab and submits with --no-lint. That option is removed by a later phase, not this dependency update. The fixed accepted requirements retain these pins. The inspected status test mocks revision data and does not exercise VCS mismatch or submission. No package installation, vendoring, image build or test was run; the claimed mismatch repair remains attributed without upstream implementation proof.

Scope: Updatebot dependency setup.
